definition.unit: anchor decisions (one Top-1 per anchor per method)
definition.fold: exclude ALL anchors of the left-out source, then re-aggregate the remaining anchors
definition.deltas: accuracy(method) - accuracy(baseline) on the remaining anchors, baselines = ['kin', 'kin_static', 'kin_b4']
definition.note: LOSO within one split is a within-dataset stability check, NOT an independent cross-domain test.
